faq.q: What is the weather like in Marbella in June 2031?
faq.a: June 2031 in Marbella averages 25°C air temperature, 21°C sea water, and 12 hours of daylight. Winds are typically Levante (east/southeast) at 5–15 knots with calm seas of 0.3–1m. Rain is rare – expect fewer than 3 wet days across the month.

faq.q: Is June a good month for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes – June offers the best balance of warm weather, calm seas, and manageable crowds. Water temperatures are comfortable for swimming by mid-month, and the Levante wind keeps conditions pleasant without being choppy. It's the start of peak season, so book early.

faq.q: Which boat is best for a group of 10 in June?
faq.a: For 10 guests, the Azimut 39 (11 pax, €749/2h) or Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax, price on request) are excellent. The Mangusta 80 (12 pax, €4,719/4h) offers more space and includes a free jet ski. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What should I wear on a boat in Marbella in June?
faq.a: Light clothing: swimwear, a cover-up, sunglasses, and a hat. Evenings can cool to 18°C, so bring a light jacket or windbreaker. Non-marking deck shoes are recommended. Sunscreen SPF 50+ is essential – the UV index in June is very high.

faq.q: Can I swim in the sea off Marbella in June?
faq.a: Yes – sea water averages 21°C in June, which is comfortable for swimming. Popular spots include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coves near Cabopino. Most charters include stops for swimming and snorkelling.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book a June boat charter?
faq.a: For June 2031, book 4–6 weeks ahead – especially for weekends and the last two weeks when peak season begins. Tier A boats (€749/2h) sell out fastest. Contact us via WhatsApp for last-minute availability.

faq.q: What are the best routes for a June boat trip from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Morning trips: head east to Cala del Faro and Cabopino (1h each way). Afternoon: west to the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina (30 min). Sunset: cruise toward La Concha for golden hour. Full-day trips can reach Estepona or Sotogrande.

data.body_html:
June 2031 is one of the best months for a marbella boat rental weather june 2031 – with average air temperatures of 25°C, sea water at 21°C, and 12 hours of daylight, conditions are near-perfect for cruising the Costa del Sol. The prevailing Levante wind keeps seas calm at 0.3–1m, and rain is virtually absent. Whether you're planning a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day exploration to Estepona, our fleet departs Puerto Banús with everything included – skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

June 2031 Weather Averages for Marbella

MetricValue
Average air temperature25°C (high 29°C / low 18°C)
Sea water temperature21°C
Daylight hours12 hours (sunrise ~07:00, sunset ~21:30)
Prevailing windLevante (E/SE) 5–15 knots
Sea stateCalm to slight (0.3–1m waves)
Rainfall~5mm total, <3 wet days
UV indexVery high (8–9) – SPF 50+ essential

These conditions make June ideal for boating. The sea is warm enough for swimming by mid-month, and the gentle breeze keeps the heat comfortable. Compare this with July and August when temperatures often exceed 35°C and crowds peak.

Why June Is Prime Time for Boat Rental in Marbella

June sits in the sweet spot between the mild spring and the scorching peak summer. Water temperatures reach 21°C by the second week – perfect for swimming at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The Levante wind, typical for this time of year, creates a steady 5–15 knot breeze that keeps the air fresh without making the sea choppy. Visibility underwater is excellent, often exceeding 15m, making snorkelling rewarding.

With 12 hours of daylight, you can schedule a morning departure (10:00–14:00), an afternoon cruise (15:00–19:00), or a sunset trip (20:30–22:30). Sunset over La Concha mountain is spectacular in June, with the sun setting behind the peak around 21:40.

Our Fleet: Options for Every Group Size

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Here are the standout options for June:

  • Tier A (from €749/2h): Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – ideal for small groups or couples. Best value for a 2-hour sunset cruise.
  • Tier B (from €4,719/4h): Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) in white or grey – includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a full-day party or celebration.
  • Other boats (price on request via WhatsApp): Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and more. Contact us for custom quotes.

For larger groups, the Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) or K80 (24m, 12 pax) offer spacious decks and luxury amenities. Need a smaller boat? The Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) is great for an intimate trip.

Best Routes and Itineraries for June

Based on June's calm seas and long daylight, here are three recommended itineraries:

  • 2-Hour Sunset Cruise (€749): Depart Puerto Banús at 20:30, cruise west along the Golden Mile toward Marbella Marina, watch the sunset over La Concha, and return by 22:30. Includes drinks and snacks.
  • 4-Hour Morning Trip (from €4,719): Head east to Cala del Faro (30 min), stop for swimming and snorkelling, then continue to Cabopino (20 min) for a beach break. Return via the coast, spotting villas and yachts.
  • Full-Day (8h) Luxury Charter: Cruise south to Estepona (1h each way) for lunch at a beach club, then west to Sotogrande (another 30 min) for an afternoon swim. The Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80 are perfect for this.

All routes depart from Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's yachting scene.

What's Included – No Hidden Costs

Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT) – no extra taxes

Tier B charters (Mangusta 80) also include a free jet ski for the duration. No hidden fees – the price you see is the price you pay.

Booking Tips for June 2031

  • Book early: Peak season starts mid-June. Reserve 4–6 weeks ahead, especially for weekends and Tier A boats.
  • WhatsApp for custom requests: Need a specific boat or itinerary? Contact us via WhatsApp for instant quotes on boats like the Pershing 46 or Lagoon 380.
  • Check the wind: Levante is normal, but if Poniente (west) blows, seas can be choppier – our skippers adjust routes accordingly.
  • Sun protection: UV index 8–9 – bring SPF 50+, a hat, and sunglasses. The skipper provides shade on all boats.

For more details on our complete fleet, visit our Marbella boat rental hub.
